rationale: naf-claude-agentic: val_n=214, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_hidden=64, naf_layers=3, naf_n_iter=3000, naf_lr=0.04, naf_tv_weight=0.0001, naf_n_clip=0.05, naf_outer_wall_s=1080, naf_per_scene_s=5.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-5 (search-20260619-01, naf). SIX-BOX. (1) NUMBERS trajectory (monotone climb via leanness+lr, all hr=0): iter-1 hidden=128,layers=4,lr=1e-2 -> SSIM 0.4729 (PSNR 18.55, baseline_PSNR 34.08, elapsed 1097s, median ~91 Adam steps/scene at the 5.0s per-scene wall, 18-min outer wall 1080s hit EXACTLY at scene 214). iter-2 hidden 128->64 -> SSIM 0.4943 (+0.0215, PSNR 18.62). iter-3 layers 4->3 -> SSIM 0.5452 (+0.0509, PSNR 19.238, RMSE 0.005459). iter-4 lr 1e-2->2e-2 -> SSIM 0.5629 (+0.0177, PSNR 20.276, RMSE 0.004843, elapsed 1095.5s, params 0.006465M) = BEST. Still FAR below the LD-FBP cal floor (~0.81). (2) FAILURE MODE / LIMITER: budget-starved per-scene INR fit. The per-scene 5.0s t_limit (solver fit_one_scene break) governs, naf_n_iter=3000 is just a high cap; only ~90-100 Adam steps/scene leave the NeRF-style coordinate-MLP barely off its init_mu=0.005 water-mu init (a NeRF wants hundreds-to-thousands). Total budget 214x5.0s=1070s~=1080s outer wall is FULL inside the 20-min compute budget and CANNOT be raised. (3) ONE KNOB: naf_lr 2e-2->4e-2 (naf_hidden=64, naf_layers=3, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_per_scene_s=5.0, naf_outer_wall_s=1080, val_n=214 ALL UNCHANGED). The two LEANNESS levers are spent: hidden hit 64 (iter-2), layers hit 3 (iter-3) -- layers 3->2 zeros the range(layers-2) hidden loop -> single Linear(in,64)->Linear(64,1) perceptron capacity-cliff; n_freqs->6 trades positional-encoding bandwidth. lr is the ORTHOGONAL lever attacking the diagnosed too-few-steps-off-init failure WITHOUT shrinking the fixed model: in the ~90-100-step init-anchored Adam regime a higher lr travels further off init per step. iter-4 already PROVED this axis (1e-2->2e-2 gave +0.0177, PSNR up, RMSE down, NO instability), so continue it with another measured 2x step. Model held fixed so the SSIM delta isolates lr cleanly. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if naf_lr 2e-2->4e-2, SSIM rises above 0.5629 because each of the ~90-100 per-scene steps moves the INR further off its water-mu init within the same per-scene wall (same mechanism that gave iter-4 +0.0177). FALSIFIER: if SSIM stalls at ~0.56 or DROPS (lr-induced instability in the short Adam fit), the lr lever is exhausted -> NAF has hit the practical per-scene-INR ceiling in a 5s/214-scene budget (~0.56 vs LD-FBP ~0.81), a STRUCTURAL NEGATIVE on dense 2304-view Mayo (wrong inductive bias for dense-view CT) to document toward iter-20. (5) HARD 20-min budget: 214-scene pass, naf_outer_wall_s=1080 (18 min, in-solver outer wall = governor) + naf_per_scene_s=5.0 (in-solver per-scene wall; naf_n_iter=3000 stays a high cap so the WALL governs). 214x5.0s=1070s~=1080s outer wall (hit exactly at scene 214 every iter; measured elapsed 1094.6-1100s, well inside the 30-min sbatch kill). lr change is cost-free. val_n=214 (ALL L277 slices, NOT reduced), 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov= override). (6) no control return; the loop dispatches the next iter.
